{{Quote|You have credits, you can take route!|Biguh Johs|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Biguh Johs''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] and ran a taxi service, taking passengers from the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Raider's Cove]] on [[Horizon Island]] to the nearby [[Sky Ridge Island]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Biguh Johs appears on the planet Rishi as a taxi stop in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'', a [[2014]] Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Biguh Johs and the two other taxi stops on Rishi, [[Bluuto Karlabasy]] and [[Dakon Agapoui]], mark the first time that non-[[Droid/Legends|droid]] characters have been used for taxi stops; all other worlds and Daily Areas use [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]].<ref name="TOR" />
